user.title: Connect to Apple Music API
user.description: Enter the host and port of your apple-music-api server running on your Mac.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Mac running the server.
data_description.port: Port the server listens on (8181 by default).
data_description.api_key: Only needed if the server was installed with an API key. The installer prints it once; leave blank otherwise.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Apple Music API
reconfigure.description: Update the API key for your apple-music-api server. Leave the key blank if the server does not require one.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Mac running the server. To connect a different server, add a new integration entry instead.
data_description.port: Port the server listens on (8181 by default).
data_description.api_key: The key configured on the server (API_KEY). Leave blank if the server does not require one.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Apple Music API
reauth_confirm.description: The apple-music-api server at {host} rejected Home Assistant's requests. Enter the server's current API key. If the server uses an IP allowlist (ALLOWED_IPS), also make sure it includes Home Assistant's IP address.

data_description.api_key: The key configured on the server (API_KEY).

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect. Make sure the server is running and the host/port are correct.
error.invalid_auth: The server rejected the request. Check the API key, and if the server uses an IP allowlist (ALLOWED_IPS), make sure it includes Home Assistant's IP address.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This Apple Music server is already configured.
abort.already_in_progress: Setup for this Apple Music server is already in progress.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: Host and port must stay the same when reconfiguring. To connect a different server, add a new Apple Music integration entry.
